title: Classified Navy diver unit experimenting with liquid breathing

plain: A secret unit of US Navy divers has experimented with liquid breathing, the idea of breathing an oxygen-rich liquid instead of air, according to Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy rear admiral. He tells Michels there is "a special unit, I'm not going to say exactly where, of Navy divers that have experimented with that technology," speaking as someone who says he knows of it directly. If true, it would mean the Navy is quietly working on ways for people to go deeper and stay longer under the sea.
